name: Metal roofing
summary: Standing-seam and exposed-fastener metal roofs priced from pitched squares, trim, boots and tear-off.

items.label: Exposed-fastener panels with underlayment
items.source: 40x30 ft at 4/12 (x1.054) = 12.648 roof squares (index.html); 8% waste -> 1.6 h and $195 per panel square x 1.08, plus underlayment $38 per roof square (suggestedPanelKit('exposed') in calc.mjs, index.html)

items.label: Ridge, rake and eave trim
items.source: 40 ridge + 60 rake + 80 eave lf (index.html); 0.08 h/lf; ($9x40 + $7x60 + $6x80)/180 = $7.00/lf (index.html rates)

items.label: Travel, mobilization and equipment
items.source: Travel hours 0.8 (siteHours); mobilization $350 + travel and equipment $160 (index.html defaults). Trip/setup 3 h is setupHours

specialistModels: Pitch multipliers, panel-type kits with waste and seamer rental, hip/valley waste, tear-off and dumpster, story height, snow guards, ice-and-water and permit toggles.
